scripts.dev:api: bun run build:tls && bun --cwd apps/api dev
scripts.build:tls: cd tools/tls-fetch && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -mod=vendor -trimpath -o bin/tls-fetch .
scripts.check:tls: cd tools/tls-fetch && go vet -mod=vendor ./... && go test -mod=vendor ./...
scripts.build: bun --cwd apps/web build && bun --cwd apps/docs build
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run check:tls && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
